description.value: This study investigated the neural basis of individual variation in emotion regulation, focusing on cognitive reappraisal of negative stimuli and its relation to task activation and resting-state functional connectivity.

spans.text: This study investigated the neural basis of individual variation in emotion regulation, specifically the ability to reappraise negative stimuli so as to down-regulate negative affect.
